channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: India’s First Transgender Football League Kicks Off in Kolkata, Empowering 200+ Players
item.description: Kolkata's groundbreaking eight-day tournament unites 16 teams of over 200 transgender athletes, fostering inclusion through football amid historic rights advocacy.

item.title: Leading From the Front: Sunil Chhetri’s Remarkable Rise as an Indian Football Legend
item.description: Sunil Chhetri has amassed 252 career goals, cementing his status as India's greatest ever striker and a global icon.

item.title: Delhi Man Quits Corporate Job in 2019 to Lead Earth Warriors Cleaning Yamuna, 12 States Tonnes Waste
item.description: Pankaj Kumar quit corporate life to found Earth Warriors, cleaning rivers weekly across 12 states.

item.title: From Plastic Bat to World Cricket: Hyderabad’s Shree Charani Emerges as India’s Left-Arm Spin Answer
item.description: Hyderabad's 20-year-old left-arm spinner Shree Charani rises from village playgrounds to India A stardom, offering a timely fix for Team India's spin woes after Jadeja's retirement.

item.title: Christmas Strikes Derailed Swiggy Zomato Deliveries: Gig Workers Expose 10-Min Delivery’s Deadly Toll
item.description: Gig workers from major platforms staged timed protests demanding fair wages, safety reforms, and social security amid new labour laws.

item.title: People of Purpose: Early Lessons in Service That Continue to Shape Pearl Tiwari’s Work at Ambuja Foundation
item.description: Pearl Tiwari blends NGO passion with corporate strategy at Ambuja Foundation, prioritizing water, women, and livelihoods to empower 4,500 rural villages across India.

item.title: One Killed, Four Injured After Helium Balloon Gas Cylinder Explodes Near Mysuru Palace Gate in Karnataka
item.description: A fatal helium cylinder explosion near Mysuru Palace killed a migrant vendor and injured five unsuspecting tourists.

item.title: Yogi Adityanath Accuses Opposition of ‘Selective Activism’, Questions Silence on Killing of Dalit Hindu in Bangladesh
item.description: Yogi Adityanath has sparked a fierce debate by accusing Opposition leaders and activists of ignoring attacks on Hindus in Bangladesh while vocally protesting violence in Gaza.

item.title: Delhi Court Acquits All Three Accused in 2009 Panipat Acid Attack Case After 16 Years; Survivor Shaheen Malik Devastated
item.description: After sixteen years of legal struggle, a Delhi court acquitted all in the Panipat acid attack case.

item.title: From Streets to Shelters: Netherlands Becomes World’s First Nation With No Stray Dogs – Giving Every Dog a Home Forever
item.description: The Netherlands has been widely hailed as the first country to virtually eliminate stray dogs from its streets by combining strict animal welfare laws, free mass sterilisation and vaccination, and a strong culture of adoption over abandonment.
